enrichment.summary: The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) a contract with an Oakland consultant, for up to $57,500, for the 2020-2021 school year at Franklin Elementary School. The contractor will run daily support groups and one-on-one help for "at promise" students, contact their parents by phone or home visits, train Franklin staff, and hold parent workshops in families' primary languages. The service period began August 1, 2020, before the board's August 26 meeting.

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $35,000 for a health advocacy contractor at Rudsdale Newcomer High
enrichment.summary: The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) a contract with a San Leandro contractor, for up to $35,000, at Rudsdale Newcomer High School. The contractor will help students navigate the health care system, create a training for students to become health advocates, teach a Health Advocacy elective on Wednesdays, and join the school team that supports students with MediCal and appointments. The service period starts August 3, 2020, before the board's August 26 meeting; the end date as printed is June 30, 2020, which appears to be a typo.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
